title: O‘tmishdagi davomli harakat va hikoya
goal_uz: Dars oxirida past continuous va past simple’ni farqlaysiz, when va while’dan to‘g‘ri foydalanasiz hamda fon, voqea va oqibatdan iborat bir daqiqalik kutilmagan voqea haqida hikoya qila olasiz.

scenes.title: O‘tmish hikoyasi
scenes.say: Hello! Last time we studied the present perfect. Today you will learn how to tell a good story about the past.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda present perfect’ni, ya’ni tajriba va natijani o‘rgandik. Bugun o‘tmish haqida chiroyli hikoya aytishni o‘rganamiz. Buning uchun ikki zamon kerak: voqealar uchun past simple va fon uchun past continuous. Dars oxirida bir daqiqalik kutilmagan voqea haqida hikoya qila olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Oldingi darsda present perfect’ni o‘rgandik. Bugun o‘tmish haqida yaxshi hikoya qilishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Shakli: was / were + V-ing
board: I / he / she / it + was + V-ing
Inkor: wasn't / weren't. Savol: Was he ...?

examples.t: I was cooking dinner.
They were playing football.
Was she sleeping?

scenes.say: I was cooking dinner. They were playing football. Was she sleeping? We use was or were with the verb and ing.
scenes.say_native: Past continuous — was yoki were va fe’lga -ing. I, he, she, it bilan “was”; you, we, they bilan “were”. Inkorda wasn’t yoki weren’t, savolda was yoki were gap boshiga chiqadi. O‘zbekchada “-ayotgan edi” shakliga to‘g‘ri keladi: “ovqat tayyorlayotgan edim”. Bu shakl sizga tanish, shuning uchun ingliz tilidagi mantiq oson o‘rnashadi.
scenes.say_uz: Men kechki ovqat tayyorlayotgan edim. Ular futbol o‘ynayotgan edi. U uxlayotgan edimi? Was yoki were va -ing ishlatamiz.

scenes.title: Imlo: -ing qo‘shish

examples.t: He was running in the park.
We were making a cake.

scenes.say: Run, running. Make, making. Lie, lying. Study, studying. Spelling changes are small, but important.
scenes.say_native: Imlo qoidalari. Bir bo‘g‘inli, undosh-unli-undosh bilan tugagan fe’llarda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: run — running, swim — swimming. Jim -e bilan tugasa, -e tushadi: make — making, write — writing. “Lie” — “lying”. “Study” — “studying”, y qoladi. Bu qoidalar present continuous’da ham aynan shunday.
scenes.say_uz: Run, running. Make, making. Lie, lying. Study, studying. Imlo o‘zgarishlari kichik, lekin muhim.

scenes.title: Birinchi vazifa: o‘tmishdagi jarayon
board: At 8 o'clock I was having dinner.

examples.t: At eight I was having dinner.
examples.uz: Soat sakkizda kechki ovqat qilayotgan edim.

examples.t: This time last year I was living in Samarkand.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yili shu paytda Samarqandda yashayotgan edim.

examples.t: What were you doing at 9 last night?
examples.uz: Kecha soat to‘qqizda nima qilayotgan eding?

scenes.say: At eight I was having dinner. This time last year I was living in Samarkand. What were you doing at nine last night?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi vazifa: o‘tmishdagi aniq paytda davom etayotgan jarayon. “At eight I was having dinner” — soat sakkizda ovqatlanish jarayonining o‘rtasida edim. Qachon boshlanib, qachon tugagani noma’lum. Mana shu ma’no past simple’dan farq qiladi. Savol: “What were you doing at nine last night?” Bu so‘roq ko‘pincha detektiv hikoyalarida ham uchraydi.
scenes.say_uz: Soat sakkizda kechki ovqat qilayotgan edim. O‘tgan yili shu paytda Samarqandda yashayotgan edim. Kecha soat to‘qqizda nima qilayotgan eding?

scenes.title: Ikkinchi vazifa: fon
board: It was raining and people were hurrying home.
Past continuous = SAHNA, past simple = VOQEA

examples.t: It was raining and the streets were empty.
examples.uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi va ko‘chalar bo‘sh edi.

examples.t: The sun was shining and birds were singing.

scenes.say: It was raining and the streets were empty. The sun was shining and birds were singing. This is the background of the story.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi vazifa: fon yaratish. Hikoyani boshlaganda sahnani chizamiz: ob-havo, joy, odamlar nima qilayotgani. “It was raining and the streets were empty.” Bu past continuous. Keyin voqea boshlanganda past simple. Kinoga o‘xshatish mumkin: avval kamera manzarani ko‘rsatadi, keyin voqea sodir bo‘ladi. O‘zbekchada ham “yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi” deb boshlaymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi va ko‘chalar bo‘sh edi. Quyosh charaqlab turardi, qushlar sayrardi. Bu hikoyaning foni.

scenes.title: Soat qanday paytda?
scenes.say: Complete with the past continuous. One: at seven a.m. I, have, breakfast. Two: at nine p.m. they, watch, TV. Three: what you, do, at midnight? Four: she not sleep at eleven.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni past continuous bilan to‘ldiring. Har bir gapda aniq payt bor: soat yetti, to‘qqiz, yarim tun, o‘n bir. Savol va inkorni ham to‘g‘ri tuzing. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring. Bir: ertalab yettida nonushta qilayotgan edim. Ikki: kechki to‘qqizda ular televizor ko‘rayotgan edi. Uch: yarim tunda nima qilayotgan eding? To‘rt: u o‘n birda uxlamayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: was having. Two: were watching. Three: were you doing. Four: wasn't sleeping.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “was having”. Ikki — “were watching”, they bilan were. Uch — “were you doing”. To‘rt — “wasn’t sleeping”. Agar was va were’ni adashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, yodlab oling: faqat I, he, she, it bilan was.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: was having. Ikki: were watching. Uch: were you doing. To‘rt: wasn't sleeping.

scenes.title: Uchinchi vazifa: to‘xtatilgan harakat
board: I was walking when I saw an accident.

examples.t: I was walking home when I saw an accident.
She was cooking when the lights went out.
We were watching a film when the phone rang.

scenes.say: I was walking home when I saw an accident. She was cooking when the lights went out. We were watching a film when the phone rang.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi vazifa — to‘xtatilgan harakat. Uzoq davom etayotgan jarayon past continuous’da, uni to‘xtatgan qisqa voqea past simple’da. “I was walking home when I saw an accident.” Yurish davom etayotgan edi, avariyani ko‘rish qisqa lahza. Chizma sifatida tasavvur qiling: uzun chiziq va uning ustida bitta nuqta. Chiziq — continuous, nuqta — simple.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga piyoda ketayotib, avariyani ko‘rdim. U ovqat pishirayotganda chiroq o‘chdi. Film ko‘rayotganimizda telefon jiringladi.

scenes.title: When va while
board: as ham ishlatiladi: as I was leaving

examples.t: When the phone rang, I was cooking.
examples.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

examples.t: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
As I was leaving, she called.
examples.uz: Men chiqib ketayotganimda u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

scenes.say: When the phone rang, I was cooking. While I was cooking, the phone rang. As I was leaving, she called.
scenes.say_native: When va while. Odatda “when” dan keyin qisqa voqea: “When the phone rang”. “While” dan keyin esa davom etayotgan jarayon: “While I was cooking”. Ikkala gapda ma’no bir xil, faqat tartib o‘zgargan. “As” ham “while” kabi ishlatiladi: “as I was leaving”. Gap boshida ishlatilsa, vergul qo‘yamiz, oxirida bo‘lsa vergul shart emas.
scenes.say_uz: Telefon jiringlaganda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim. Men ovqat pishirayotganimda telefon jiringladi. Chiqib ketayotganimda u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

scenes.title: Ikki jarayon bir vaqtda

examples.t: While I was studying, my brother was playing music.
examples.uz: Men o‘qiyotganimda akam musiqa qo‘yib o‘ynayotgan edi.

examples.t: She was talking while he was driving.
examples.uz: U gaplashayotgan edi, u esa mashina haydayotgan edi.

scenes.say: While I was studying, my brother was playing music. She was talking while he was driving. Two long actions at the same time.
scenes.say_native: Ikki harakat bir vaqtda davom etsa, ikkalasi ham past continuous bo‘ladi. “While I was studying, my brother was playing music.” Ikki uzun chiziq yonma-yon turibdi. Bu hikoyada fon yaratishning yana bir usuli. Bunda hech qanday to‘xtatuvchi voqea yo‘q, shunchaki ikki parallel jarayon.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qiyotganimda akam musiqa o‘ynayotgan edi. U gaplashayotgan edi, u esa mashina haydayotgan edi. Ikki uzun harakat bir vaqtda.

scenes.title: Qisqa voqea uchun continuous emas
board: ✗ I was seeing an accident while I was walking.
✓ I saw an accident while I was walking.
✗ When she was arriving, I was cooking.
scenes.say: Not: I was seeing an accident. Say: I saw an accident while I was walking. Short events use the past simple.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: qisqa voqeani ham continuous qilish. “I was seeing an accident” — xato. Ko‘rish qisqa lahza, shuning uchun “I saw an accident”. Xuddi shunday, “arrive” qisqa voqea: “When she arrived, I was cooking”, “when she was arriving” emas. Qoida: lahzaviy voqea — past simple, davom etgan jarayon — past continuous.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I was seeing an accident. To‘g‘risi: I saw an accident while I was walking. Qisqa voqea uchun past simple.

scenes.title: Holat fe’llari
board: ✗ She was wanting a coffee. → ✓ She wanted a coffee.
scenes.say: Not: I was knowing. Say: I knew. State verbs such as know, want, like are not normally used in the continuous.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi xato: holat fe’llarini continuous qilish. Know, want, like, love, need, understand fe’llari odatda continuous bo‘lmaydi. Shuning uchun “I knew the answer” deymiz, “I was knowing” emas. O‘zbekchada “bilib turgan edim” desak ham mumkin, inglizchada esa mumkin emas. Agar fe’l holatni ko‘rsatsa, past simple ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I was knowing. To‘g‘risi: I knew. Know, want, like kabi holat fe’llari odatda continuous bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: When yoki while?
board: 1) I was sleeping ___ the alarm rang.
2) ___ he was driving, he was listening to music.
4) The lights ___ (go out) when we ___ (have) dinner.
scenes.say: When or while? One: I was sleeping blank the alarm rang. Two: blank he was driving, he was listening to music. Three: she see a fox while she walk. Four: the lights go out when we have dinner.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchisida when yoki while? Qisqa voqea alarm rang. Ikkinchisida ikki jarayon. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchisida fe’llarni to‘g‘ri zamonda yozing: qaysi biri uzoq, qaysi biri qisqa? Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: When yoki while? Bir: budilnik jiringlaganda uxlayotgan edim. Ikki: mashina haydayotganda u musiqa tinglayotgan edi. Uch: u yurib ketayotganda tulki ko‘rdi. To‘rt: kechki ovqat paytida chiroq o‘chdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: when. Two: while. Three: she saw a fox while she was walking. Four: the lights went out when we were having dinner.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — when, chunki jiringlash qisqa voqea. Ikki — while, ikki jarayon. Uch — “saw” va “was walking”. To‘rt — “went out” va “were having”. Qisqa voqea past simple, jarayon past continuous. Shu qoidani bilsangiz, yarim yo‘lni bosib o‘tdingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: when. Ikki: while. Uch: saw, was walking. To‘rt: went out, were having.

scenes.title: Past simple va past continuous
board: I read a book. (tugatdim) / I was reading a book. (tugatganim noma’lum)

examples.t: I wrote a letter last night.
I was writing a letter when you called.
examples.uz: Siz qo‘ng‘iroq qilganingizda xat yozayotgan edim.

examples.t: He painted the room.
He was painting the room.
examples.uz: U xonani bo‘yayotgan edi (tugagan yoki yo‘qligi noma’lum).

scenes.say: I wrote a letter last night, so it is finished. I was writing a letter when you called, and we do not know if I finished.
scenes.say_native: Endi ikki zamon o‘rtasidagi ma’no farqi. Past simple butun, tugagan voqeani bildiradi: “He painted the room” — xona to‘liq bo‘yalgan. Past continuous jarayonning o‘rtasini ko‘rsatadi: “He was painting the room” — bo‘yayotgan edi, tugatgan-tugatmagani noma’lum. Bu farq o‘zbek tilida ko‘pincha kontekstdan chiqadi, inglizchada esa zamon bilan beriladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha xat yozdim, u tugagan. Siz qo‘ng‘iroq qilganingizda xat yozayotgan edim, tugatganim noma’lum.

scenes.title: Ketma-ket voqealar
board: I opened the door and went in.

examples.t: When I got home, I took off my coat.
When I got home, she was cooking.
examples.uz: Uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

scenes.say: When I got home, I took off my coat. When I got home, she was cooking. Different order, different meaning.
scenes.say_native: Birin-ketin sodir bo‘lgan voqealar ikkalasi ham past simple’da: “When I got home, I took off my coat” — avval keldim, keyin paltoni yechdim. Lekin “When I got home, she was cooking” — kelganimda u allaqachon pishirayotgan edi. Ko‘rdingizmi, bir xil “when”, lekin zamon ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. Buni o‘zbekchada ko‘pincha faqat kontekst aytib turadi.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga kelgach, paltomni yechdim. Uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi. Tartib boshqa, ma’no boshqa.

scenes.title: Simple yoki continuous?
board: 1) He ___ (paint) the kitchen. It looks great now.
2) He ___ (paint) the kitchen when I arrived.
scenes.say: Simple or continuous? One: he paint the kitchen, it looks great now. Two: he paint the kitchen when I arrived. Three: when I arrive, they leave, one after another. Four: when I arrive, they play cards, already playing.
scenes.say_native: Past simple yoki continuous? Birinchisida oshxona tayyor. Ikkinchisida jarayon. Uchinchisida ular men kelganimdan keyin ketishgan. To‘rtinchisida men kelganimda ular allaqachon o‘ynayotgan edi. Ma’noga qarab tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: Simple yoki continuous? Bir: u oshxonani bo‘yadi, hozir zo‘r ko‘rinyapti. Ikki: men kelganimda u oshxonani bo‘yayotgan edi. Uch: men kelganimda ular ketishdi. To‘rt: men kelganimda ular karta o‘ynayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: painted. Two: was painting. Three: arrived, left. Four: arrived, were playing.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “painted”, tugagan. Ikki — “was painting”, jarayon. Uch — “arrived” va “left”, birin-ketin. To‘rt — “arrived” va “were playing”, o‘ynash allaqachon davom etayotgan edi. Ma’noga qarab tanlash bu bobning asosiy qoidasi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: painted. Ikki: was painting. Uch: arrived, left. To‘rt: arrived, were playing.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol shakllari
board: I wasn't sleeping. / They weren't working.
Was he waiting? — Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
Wh- savol: What was she doing? Where were they going?

examples.t: I wasn't listening when he spoke.
examples.uz: U gapirganda men quloq solmayotgan edim.

examples.t: Was it raining when you left?
Where were they going?

scenes.say: I wasn't listening when he spoke. Was it raining when you left? Where were they going?
scenes.say_native: Inkor va savol shakllari oddiy. Inkorda wasn’t yoki weren’t: “I wasn’t listening”. Savolda was yoki were gap boshiga chiqadi: “Was it raining?”. Qisqa javobda “Yes, it was” yoki “No, it wasn’t”. So‘roq so‘zlari bilan: “What was she doing?”, “Where were they going?”. Bu yerda did yoki do kerak emas, chunki was va were o‘zi yordamchi fe’l.
scenes.say_uz: U gapirganda men quloq solmayotgan edim. Siz ketayotganda yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edimi? Ular qayerga ketayotgan edi?

scenes.title: Savol va inkor tuzing
scenes.say: Make questions and negatives. One: she was reading, make a question. Two: they were playing, make a negative. Three: he was driving, ask what. Four: it was snowing, ask and answer.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni o‘zgartiring. Birinchisini savolga aylantiring. Ikkinchisini inkorga. Uchinchisida “what” bilan savol tuzing. To‘rtinchisida savol bering va qisqa javob ayting. Did yoki do ishlatmang.
scenes.say_uz: Savol va inkor tuzing. Bir: u o‘qiyotgan edi, savolga aylantiring. Ikki: ular o‘ynayotgan edi, inkorga aylantiring. Uch: u mashina haydayotgan edi, nima deb so‘rang. To‘rt: qor yog‘ayotgan edi, so‘rang va javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) What was he driving? / What was he doing?
4) Was it snowing? Yes, it was.
scenes.say: Was she reading? They weren't playing. What was he doing? Was it snowing? Yes, it was.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “Was she reading?”. Ikki — “They weren’t playing”. Uch — “What was he doing?”. To‘rt — “Was it snowing? Yes, it was.” Hech qaysisida did yoki do yo‘q. Shu yerda xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, qoidani eslang: was va were o‘zi yordamchi fe’l.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Was she reading? Ikki: They weren't playing. Uch: What was he doing? To‘rt: Was it snowing? Yes, it was.

scenes.title: Vaqt belgilari
board: at 8 o'clock, at that time, this time yesterday
all day, all evening, the whole morning
at the time, at that moment

examples.t: This time yesterday I was flying to Dubai.
examples.uz: Kecha shu paytda Dubayga uchayotgan edim.

examples.t: It rained all day, but we were playing inside.
examples.uz: Kun bo‘yi yomg‘ir yog‘di, lekin biz ichkarida o‘ynayotgan edik.

examples.t: At the time, she was working abroad.
examples.uz: O‘sha paytda u chet elda ishlayotgan edi.

scenes.say: This time yesterday I was flying to Dubai. At that moment, we were playing inside. At the time, she was working abroad.
scenes.say_native: Past continuous bilan keladigan vaqt belgilari: at eight o’clock, at that time, this time yesterday, all evening, at the time, at that moment. Ularning ma’nosi — o‘sha aniq paytda jarayon davom etayotgan edi. Diqqat: “yesterday” yolg‘iz bo‘lsa, past simple bilan ham kelishi mumkin, lekin “this time yesterday” jarayonni ko‘rsatadi va continuous talab qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha shu paytda Dubayga uchayotgan edim. O‘sha payt biz ichkarida o‘ynayotgan edik. O‘sha paytda u chet elda ishlayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Takrorlanuvchi va g‘azabli odat
board: always + past continuous = g‘ashga tegadigan takror
He was always losing his keys.
Oddiy odat uchun: used to / past simple

examples.t: He was always losing his keys.
examples.uz: U doim kalitlarini yo‘qotib qo‘yardi (g‘ashga tegardi).

examples.t: She was constantly talking.

scenes.say: He was always losing his keys. She was constantly talking. This sounds annoying, so use it carefully.
scenes.say_native: Bir qiziq ishlatilish: always yoki constantly bilan past continuous g‘ashga tegadigan takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi. “He was always losing his keys” — doim kalitini yo‘qotardi, bu menga yoqmasdi. Oddiy odat uchun esa past simple yoki “used to” ishlatiladi. Bu shaklni ko‘p ishlatmang, faqat shikoyat ohangini berish uchun.
scenes.say_uz: U doim kalitlarini yo‘qotib qo‘yardi. U to‘xtovsiz gapirardi. Bu ohang g‘ashga tegadi, ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Hikoyani to‘ldiring
scenes.say: Complete the story. It was late and I was walking home. Suddenly I heard a noise. Someone was following me. I turned round. It was my cat. Fill in the correct forms.
scenes.say_native: Hikoyani to‘g‘ri zamonlarda to‘ldiring. Birinchi gapda fon: was late va was walking. Ikkinchi gapda to‘satdan voqea. Uchinchi gapda fon. To‘rtinchida voqea va tafsilot. Qaysi biri jarayon, qaysi biri voqea ekanini o‘ylang.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyani to‘ldiring. Kech edi va uyga ketayotgan edim. To‘satdan shovqin eshitdim. Kimdir ortimdan kelayotgan edi. Burilib qaradim. Bu mening mushugim edi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: It was late and I was walking home. Suddenly I heard a noise. Someone was following me. I turned round. It was my cat.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “It was late” — holat, was. “I was walking” — jarayon. “I heard” — voqea. “Someone was following me” — jarayon, fon. “I turned round” — voqea. “It was my cat” — holat. Ko‘rdingizmi, yarmi voqea, yarmi fon. Shu aralashma hikoyani jonli qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Kech edi va uyga ketayotgan edim. To‘satdan shovqin eshitdim. Kimdir ortimdan kelayotgan edi. Burilib qaradim. Bu mening mushugim edi.

scenes.title: Hikoya tuzilishi
scenes.say: A story has four parts. First, the scene: it was raining. Then the event: suddenly the lights went out. Then the result. Sometimes we add an earlier reason with the past perfect.
scenes.say_native: Hikoya to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi: fon — “It was raining, people were hurrying”. Ikkinchi: voqea — “Suddenly the lights went out”. Uchinchi: oqibat — “So we lit candles”. To‘rtinchi, ba’zan: oldingi sabab, bu past perfect: “I had forgotten to pay the bill”. Past perfect’ni bugun faqat tanib oling, uni keyinroq mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoya to‘rt qismdan iborat: fon, voqea, oqibat va ba’zan oldingi sabab.

scenes.title: Hikoya so‘zlari
board: meanwhile, at that moment, just then

examples.t: Suddenly, the door opened.
Meanwhile, my sister was waiting outside.
examples.uz: Shu orada singlim tashqarida kutib turgan edi.

examples.t: Just then, the phone rang.

scenes.say: Suddenly, the door opened. Meanwhile, my sister was waiting outside. Just then, the phone rang.
scenes.say_native: Hikoyani chiroyli qiladigan so‘zlar: suddenly, then, after that, finally — voqealar uchun. Meanwhile — shu orada, parallel jarayon uchun. Just then, at that moment, all of a sudden — kutilmagan payt uchun. Bu so‘zlar gapni bog‘laydi va hikoyaga ritm beradi. Ularni vergul bilan ajrating, masalan: “Suddenly, the door opened.”
scenes.say_uz: To‘satdan eshik ochildi. Shu orada singlim tashqarida kutib turgan edi. Aynan o‘sha payt telefon jiringladi.

scenes.title: Eshiting: yo‘qolgan hamyon
board: It was a cold Friday evening and I was waiting for a bus.
Suddenly I realised my wallet wasn't in my bag.
While I was searching, a boy ran up to me.
He was holding my wallet in his hand.
scenes.say: It was a cold Friday evening, and I was waiting for the bus. People were hurrying home. Suddenly I realised my wallet wasn't in my bag. While I was searching, a boy ran up to me. He was holding my wallet. I had dropped it near the shop. I thanked him and bought him an ice cream.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi hikoyani tinglang. Sovuq juma kechasi. Fon past continuous’da: kutayotgan edim, odamlar shoshilayotgan edi. Keyin voqealar past simple’da: angladim, yugurib keldi. Oxirida past perfect: tushirib yuborgan edim. Hikoya qanday qurilganiga quloq soling.
scenes.say_uz: Sovuq juma kechasi, avtobus kutayotgan edim. Odamlar uyga shoshilayotgan edi. To‘satdan hamyonim sumkamda yo‘qligini angladim. Qidirayotganimda bir bola yugurib keldi. U qo‘lida hamyonimni ushlab turgan edi. Men uni do‘kon yonida tushirib yuborgan edim. Unga rahmat aytdim va muzqaymoq sotib berdim.

scenes.title: Hikoya bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say: Four questions. What was the weather like? What was the speaker doing? What did the speaker realise? What was the boy holding?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Ob-havo qanday edi? Gapiruvchi nima qilayotgan edi? U nimani angladi? Bola nimani ushlab turgan edi? To‘liq gap bilan, to‘g‘ri zamonda javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Ob-havo qanday edi? Gapiruvchi nima qilayotgan edi? U nimani angladi? Bola nimani ushlab turgan edi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) He was waiting for a bus.
3) His wallet wasn't in his bag.
scenes.say: It was cold. He was waiting for a bus. He realised his wallet wasn't in his bag. The boy was holding the wallet.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — sovuq edi. Ikki — avtobus kutayotgan edi. Uch — hamyoni sumkada yo‘qligini angladi. To‘rt — bola hamyonni ushlab turgan edi. Ko‘rdingizmi: savolning zamoni javobning zamonini ham belgilaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Sovuq edi. Avtobus kutayotgan edi. Hamyoni sumkada yo‘qligini angladi. Bola hamyonni ushlab turgan edi.

scenes.title: Eshiting: kutilmagan uchrashuv
board: A: What were you doing at ten last night? I called.
B: I was walking in the park.
B: Guess who I met! I was sitting on a bench when Jim sat next to me.
A: Jim? We hadn't seen him for years!
scenes.say: What were you doing at ten last night? I called you twice. Sorry, I was walking in the park. Guess who I met! I was sitting on a bench when a man sat next to me. It was Jim! He was wearing a big hat, so I didn't recognise him at first.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — odatiy suhbat. Birinchi odam kechagi paytni so‘raydi: “What were you doing at ten last night?” Ikkinchisi jarayon bilan javob beradi, keyin to‘xtatuvchi voqeani aytadi. E’tibor bering: “wearing a big hat” ham fon, “didn’t recognise” esa voqea.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha soat o‘nda nima qilayotgan eding? Ikki marta qo‘ng‘iroq qildim. Kechir, bog‘da yurgan edim. Kimni uchratganimni bilasanmi! Skameykada o‘tirgan edim, bir erkak yoniga o‘tirdi. U Jim edi! U katta shlyapa kiyib olgan edi, shuning uchun darrov tanimadim.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What was B doing at ten?
scenes.say: Four questions. What was B doing at ten? Where was B sitting? What was Jim wearing? Why didn't B recognise Jim?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. B soat o‘nda nima qilayotgan edi? U qayerda o‘tirgan edi? Jim nima kiyib olgan edi? B nega uni tanimadi?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. B soat o‘nda nima qilayotgan edi? U qayerda o‘tirgan edi? Jim nima kiygan edi? B nega uni tanimadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: He was walking in the park. He was sitting on a bench. Jim was wearing a big hat. The hat covered his face, so he didn't recognise him.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — bog‘da yurgan edi. Ikki — skameykada o‘tirgan edi. Uch — katta shlyapa kiygan edi. To‘rt — shlyapa tufayli. Bu hikoyada ham fon va voqea almashib turibdi, bu ingliz tilidagi og‘zaki hikoyaning asosiy uslubi.
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘da yurgan edi. Skameykada o‘tirgan edi. Katta shlyapa kiygan edi. Shlyapa tufayli tanimadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: was va were
scenes.say: In normal speech, was is weak: /wəz/. Were is /wə/. Only in short answers they are strong: Yes, I was.
scenes.say_native: Odatiy nutqda “was” kuchsiz — /wəz/, “were” esa /wə/. “I was walking” — /aɪ wəz ˈwɔːkɪŋ/. Lekin qisqa javobda ular kuchli: “Yes, I was” — /wɒz/. Shuningdek -ing oxirida g deyarli eshitilmaydi, burun tovushi /ŋ/ chiqadi. Asosiy fe’lga urg‘u beriladi, yordamchiga emas.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy nutqda was kuchsiz: /wəz/, were — /wə/. Qisqa javobda kuchli: Yes, I was.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say: I was walking home. They were waiting for us. What were you doing? It was raining.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Yordamchi fe’lni qisqa, kuchsiz aytib, urg‘uni asosiy so‘zga bering: WALKing, WAITing, DOing, RAINing. Tez va tekis ritm.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: uyga piyoda ketayotgan edim. Ular bizni kutayotgan edi. Nima qilayotgan eding? Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Tekshirish
scenes.say: Stress the main verbs. The helping verbs are short and quiet.
scenes.say_native: Tekshirib ko‘ring. Urg‘u WALK, WAIT, DO, RAIN bo‘g‘inlarida, was va were esa yengil. Agar “was” ni baland aytgan bo‘lsangiz, qaytadan urinib ko‘ring. Bu ritm ingliz tilini tabiiy qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy fe’llarga urg‘u bering, yordamchilar qisqa va past ovozda.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan xatolar
board: ✗ I was go to school when I met him.
✓ I was going to school when I met him.
✗ While I walked, I saw him. (jarayon) → ✓ While I was walking, I saw him.
scenes.say: Not: I was go. Say: I was going. And after while, use the continuous: while I was walking.
scenes.say_native: Yana ikki xato. Birinchisi: was bilan oddiy fe’l: “I was go”. To‘g‘risi “I was going”, albatta -ing bilan. Ikkinchisi: while dan keyin past simple: “While I walked, I saw him”. Bu aslida mumkin, lekin ma’no boshqa. Jarayonni ko‘rsatish uchun “While I was walking” aytish tabiiyroq. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi “yurganimda” umumiy shaklidan o‘tgan odat.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I was go. To‘g‘risi: I was going. While dan keyin odatda continuous: While I was walking, I saw him.

scenes.title: Kutilmagan voqea hikoyasi: namuna
scenes.say: Here is a model. It was a quiet morning and I was drinking tea. Suddenly, the lights went out. I went outside, and all the street was dark. In the end, it was just a power cut.
scenes.say_native: Namuna hikoya. “It was a quiet morning and I was drinking tea.” — fon. “Suddenly, the lights went out.” — voqea. “I went outside, and the whole street was dark.” — oqibat. Oxirida qisqa xulosa. Sizning hikoyangiz ham shu tuzilishda bo‘lsin: fon, voqea, oqibat. Shunda bir daqiqada ham tartibli, ham qiziqarli gapirasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: tinch ertalab edi va men choy ichayotgan edim. To‘satdan chiroq o‘chdi. Tashqariga chiqdim, butun ko‘cha qorong‘i edi. Oxirida oddiy elektr o‘chishi bo‘lib chiqdi.

scenes.title: O‘z hikoyangizni ayting
board: 1) Background: It was ... and I was ...
scenes.say: Your turn. Tell a short story about an unexpected event. Start with the background, then the event.
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizda. O‘ttiz soniya ichida kutilmagan voqea haqida qisqa hikoya qiling. Fon bilan boshlang: “It was ... and I was ...”. Keyin “Suddenly” bilan voqeani ayting va oqibat bilan tugating. Past continuous va past simple’ni birga ishlating.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Kutilmagan voqea haqida qisqa hikoya qiling, fon bilan boshlang, keyin voqeani ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: It was a hot afternoon and I was waiting at a bus stop.
Suddenly a dog ran past me.
A little girl was running after it.
In the end, I caught the dog.
scenes.say: It was a hot afternoon and I was waiting at a bus stop. Suddenly, a dog ran past me. A little girl was running after it. I caught the dog, and she thanked me.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob. Fon: issiq kun, bekatda kutayotgan edim. Voqea: to‘satdan it yugurib o‘tdi. Parallel jarayon: qizcha uning ketidan yugurayotgan edi. Oqibat: itni ushladim, qizcha rahmat dedi. Sizniki ham shu tartibda bo‘ldimi? Yana bir bor ayting, ikkinchi urinishda ancha ravon bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Issiq tush payti edi va men bekatda kutayotgan edim. To‘satdan it yugurib o‘tdi. Qizcha uning ketidan yugurayotgan edi. Itni ushladim, qizcha rahmat dedi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
scenes.say: Today we learned the past continuous. Remember: it paints the background of a story, and the past simple tells the events. While goes with the long action.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bir: past continuous — was yoki were va -ing. Ikki: u o‘tmishdagi aniq paytdagi jarayonni va hikoya fonini bildiradi. Uch: qisqa voqea past simple’da, uni to‘xtatgan jarayon past continuous’da. To‘rt: when odatda qisqa voqea bilan, while uzoq jarayon bilan. Besh: holat fe’llari continuous bo‘lmaydi. Shularni eslab qolsangiz, hikoyangiz jonli chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun past continuous’ni o‘rgandik. U hikoya fonini chizadi, voqealarni esa past simple aytadi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say: Your homework: tell a one-minute story about an unexpected event. Record yourself, then check your tenses.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: kutilmagan voqea haqida bir daqiqalik hikoya tayyorlang va ovoz yozib oling. Hikoyada fon past continuous’da, voqealar past simple’da bo‘lsin, when va while ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida to‘rtta past continuous va to‘rtta past simple gap. Keyingi darsda kelasi zamonning turli shakllarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: kutilmagan voqea haqida bir daqiqalik hikoya tayyorlang, ovozingizni yozib, zamonlarni tekshiring.

homework_uz: Kutilmagan voqea haqida bir daqiqalik hikoya tayyorlang va ovozingizni yozib oling. Fon past continuous’da, voqealar past simple’da bo‘lsin; when va while ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida to‘rtta past continuous va to‘rtta past simple gap.

quiz.q: I ___ home when I saw an accident.
quiz.why_uz: Uzoq jarayon, uni qisqa voqea to‘xtatdi: was walking.

quiz.q: ___ I was cooking, the phone rang.
What ___ you doing at nine last night?
quiz.why_uz: You bilan were: What were you doing?

quiz.q: When she arrived, I ___ dinner. (already cooking)
quiz.why_uz: U kelganda men allaqachon pishirayotgan edim.

quiz.q: He ___ the room. It looks great now.
They ___ football when it started to rain.
quiz.why_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshlaganda ular o‘ynayotgan edi.

quiz.q: It ___ and the streets were empty.

quiz.why_uz: Qisqa javobda yordamchi fe’l: Yes, I was.
